lines.2: 「By a vote of 39 to 62, Ellie wins!」
lines.5: 「Well, you were tougher than I expected.」
lines.7: 「Princess! You were just having fun and going with the flow, weren't you!?」
lines.8: 「Then... why couldn't I win when I took it seriously and gave it everything I had...!?」
lines.9: 「Maybe you just don't have the talent for this?」
lines.11: 「I mean, yes, I'm good at all sorts of things.」
lines.12: 「Take tennis, for example. If I wanted to be the best in the world, I'd still have to devote myself to tennis for years and years. The world isn't that easy.」
lines.13: 「But I can beat ordinary people around here with ease, without even trying.」
lines.14: 「...You see what I'm saying, don't you?」
lines.16: 「You wrote one script that made it to the prefectural competition. Did you really think it could beat prose spun by a mind with its sights set on the world?」
lines.19: 「Now then, as the winner, I'll take my prize.」
lines.22: The Princess yanked me toward her.
lines.24: 「Maybe I'll take Tsushima as my prize.」
lines.25: The Princess gave me a light hug.
lines.27: 「I'm the one who lost! Hit me, insult me all you want--take it out on me instead!」
lines.28: 「Tsushima has nothing to do with this! Let him go!」
lines.29: 「You hear that? You certainly are loved, Tsushima.」
lines.30: 「Besides, treating a person like a prize is just wrong!」
lines.33: The Princess rubbed her cheek against mine.
lines.35: Konoe let out her most anguished cry yet.
lines.36: 「Heehee. So this is what gets to you the most. You're making such a tempting face right now.」
lines.37: 「I'll put on an even bigger show for you now, so keep watching.」
lines.38: 「You never know--my charms might dazzle him into falling for me.」
lines.40: 「Can you say that for sure right after losing to me?」
lines.44: The Princess's ponytail got a sharp yank.
lines.46: 「The rules say the loser gets no excuses. That's fine. But you are being far too merciless.」
lines.47: 「Watching you do that made me furious.」
lines.51: She left the executive committee room.
lines.52: 「Yashi, do those ballots say why each person voted that way?」
lines.53: 「Yes. Quite a few people wrote their reasons.」
lines.54: 「Let me see them for a second.」
lines.56: 「I read them too. The Princess probably won because...」
lines.59: They all said pretty much the same thing.
lines.61: 「Leo Tsushima hereby gives in to the mood and goes after Konoe.」
lines.62: 「Yeah, go. She's your girlfriend, so take care of her.」
lines.63: 「I will give the Princess a very thorough lecture.」
lines.64: 「W-why am I, the winner, being treated like this...!?」
lines.65: 「Let's make her hold a stone while she reflects on her actions.」
lines.66: 「We should take this opportunity to tell her exactly what we think.」
lines.67: 「Huh? Why is the mood suddenly so strange...? Owowow!」
lines.68: Looks like they'd be fine without me.
